configurations.name: demo-api
runtimeArgs: mkdir -p .demo/data && cd .demo && CASTOR_PORT=8100 CASTOR_DATA_DIR=./data CASTOR_DATABASE_URL=sqlite+aiosqlite:///./data/castor.db CASTOR_COOKIE_NAME=castor_demo_session CASTOR_AGENT_SECRET=demo-agent-secret CASTOR_SECRET_KEY=demo-only-secret CASTOR_CORS_ORIGINS='["http://localhost:5174"]' exec ../.venv/bin/castor-server

configurations.name: demo-web
runtimeArgs: cd web && CASTOR_API_URL=http://localhost:8100 API_INTERNAL_URL=http://localhost:8100 exec npx vite dev --port 5174 --strictPort
